description: This PHP script manages the deletion and saving of related modules in the vtiger CRM, handling HTTP request parameters, dynamically loading the relevant module, and redirecting based on action.

classes.name: $currentModule
classes.description: Dynamically instantiated class representing the current module, expected to have methods for managing related modules such as delete and save.

methods.name: delete_related_module
methods.description: Deletes related module entries based on provided IDs.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Saves related module entries associated with a specific record.
